findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "certificate-bundle" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cidr-subtract · Private data: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle, public-ip · Public sink: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle · Destructive: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle, public-ip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cidr-subtract · Private data: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle, public-ip · Public sink: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle · Destructive: cidr-cover, cidr-subtract, range-to-cidrs, certificate-bundle, public-ip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
